Large screen and simple to use for those who want convenience in their daily lives. The Hotwav A17 Pro Max features a 6.75" IPS LCD display with good visibility, as well as 256GB of storage and Android 15 for current and functional use. With complete connectivity and stable performance for basic tasks, it's an affordable choice for those looking for a straightforward and easy-to-use smartphone.


Specifications:

Model: HOTWAV A17 Pro Max

- Internal Memory: 64GB, 128GB, or 256GB (Select in the listing)

- 12 GB of Ram (6GB physical + 6GB Virtual)

- Version: Global (unlocked for all Brazilian carriers and with features enabled for Brazil)

SIM card: Dual Nano-SIM

Wireless connectivity: Wi-Fi 6 (ax/b/g/n/ac), Bluetooth 5.4

Navigation: Galileo, BeiDou, GLONASS, GPS

- Screen type: IPS LCD

- Screen size: 6.75"

- Screen resolution: HD+ (720 x 1600)

- Rear camera: Single (13 MP)

- Front camera: Single (5 MP)
